claim_boundary: This development screen can reject a frozen map. Only a new 128-prompt suite can estimate final effect size or support a paper claim. A saturated Dynamic Degree supports non-regression, never motion improvement.

dynamic_degree.claim_boundary: A constant all-one Dynamic Degree can support ceiling-level non-regression only; it cannot support a motion-improvement claim.

automatic_temporal_guard.use_boundary: Farneback diagnostics are an automatic failure guard and review localizer, not a paper metric or promotion effect size.
